_comment: Sound files for the console cue vocabulary. Drop files in this directory and name them here. Generated cue files ship here (synthesized offline, stdlib WAVs); replace any with your own recording and it is used instead. Every cue not listed falls back to a synthesized tone (see src/app/cuePlayer.ts TONES), so a half-filled manifest is fine and an empty one is fine. Paths are relative to this file. Keep them short: under 700ms, normalised, no silence at the head. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-24-capri-voice-hermes-jira-gastown.md section 2.

_cues.URGENT: a P0 alert. Three insistent tones. Rings a second time after 30s if untouched.
_cues.NEEDS_YOU: a question arrives, or a P1 alert. Two rising tones. The one that must not be missed.
_cues.FAILED: an error or a failed operation. A dull low thud. Must not resemble DONE.
_cues.DONE: a bead merged and closed. A warm two-note fall. The reward sound.
_cues.ANSWERED: an answer reached a waiting worker. One soft tick.
_cues.DISPATCHED: a worker was spawned. A short quiet click. This happens all day.
_cues.LISTENING: Capri heard the wake word. A rising blip.
_cues.COMMITTED: Capri heard execute. A short confirming chirp.
_cues.CANCEL: Capri dropped what it heard. A descending blip.
